title: The Alps
summary: Use these eighty-five nights as one winter life, not a circuit of famous names. The town is still open because the children's U12 program has to win first: recurring peers, almost-daily training, a walkable place, dependable snow and a quiet work room. Silvaplana is the strongest current read; Tignes, Val d'Isère and Crans-Montana remain live. Stay inside ninety days, then hand off to Copenhagen on Saturday, April 1.

season.summary: This is a true high-Alpine winter: cold, snow-covered and short on daylight, which is the point of the stay if a race program is real.
notes: Val d'Isère January normals are about 31°F by day and 16°F overnight, with about three inches of precipitation, mostly as snow. Recheck 2028 conditions for the valley that actually wins.
The Engadin runs colder than the French high resorts; Crans-Montana is a little milder. None of that replaces a local avalanche bulletin.
March warms and the light returns, but snow reliability still has to be a reason the base was chosen, not an afterthought.
Pack serious winter clothing, ski gear and indoor backups for storm days. Do not treat a sunny brochure photo as the daily forecast.

base.recommendation: One apartment in a real town, booked only after the ski program is real
base.reason: The Alpine base has to win on Allie and Charlie's recurring U12 training, ordinary community life, dependable snow, a quiet work room and a stay inside ninety days. A famous name is useful only if it serves that daily life. Do not rent in Val d'Isère, Tignes, Crans-Montana or the Engadin until a program can actually take them.
requirements: A confirmed U12 race-team or equivalent peer-group placement before the housing deposit
A walkable town with groceries, a bus or lift, and minimal daily driving
At least two bedrooms plus a closed-door workspace, or three bedrooms
Verified fibre or high-quality fixed broadband and strong mobile backup
Heating, laundry, a full kitchen, ski storage and blackout curtains
Written confirmation that the desk and internet can support repeated video calls
Flexible cancellation until 2027–28 program packages are published

bookFirst: Get the Apex 2100 admissions call with Britt on the calendar
Send ACM race history and current skiing video if Crans-Montana is still in play
Follow up Club des Sports de Val d'Isère, Ski Club Verbier and Ski Club de Bagnes if they have not replied
Reconnect with GR Ski Racing Team Silvaplana around July 2027 when 2027–28 packages are available
Book the winter apartment only after a program can take Allie and Charlie
Recheck 2028 lift calendars, school-holiday weeks and snow reports for the chosen valley
planningNotes: The calendar stay is eighty-five nights, and it must not exceed ninety days.
Ski Zenit and the Apex Les Crosets camps are backups, not a continuous U12 race-team placement.
Club des Sports de Tignes, PDS Racing and ESS Verbier are closed leads unless they produce a stronger club referral.
Allie's birthday is Tuesday, January 18; Brian's birthday is Sunday, March 12. Keep both inside ordinary family time, not travel days.
Copenhagen is the Saturday, April 1 handoff. Do not spend the last Alpine week adding a second valley.

programs.name: GR Ski Racing Team Silvaplana
programs.contactActivity: Active exchange — initial outreach, two detailed replies, a follow-up, a closing acknowledgement, and a July reconnect confirmation.
programs.currentRead: Program says a continuous January–March placement may work if level is appropriate; almost-daily training and possible local races.
programs.nextStep: Reconnect around July 2027 when 2027–28 packages are available.

programs.name: Apex 2100 Academy
programs.contactActivity: Active exchange — initial outreach, a camps-to-academy handoff, an admissions reply, and a sent reply proposing call times.
programs.currentRead: Winter groups are usually full with full-term academy athletes; Britt is willing to talk about whether any day-athlete or custom January–March 2028 training is possible.
programs.nextStep: Get the admissions call with Britt on the calendar.

programs.name: ACM Ski Team
programs.contactActivity: Active exchange — one outreach email and one reply; we have not sent the requested materials yet.
programs.currentRead: They do not normally take non-season athletes, but Nicolas will take the case to the technical committee. If accepted, Team International would be the pathway and trains mainly in gates.
programs.nextStep: Send race history and current skiing video if this option is still in play.

programs.name: Club des Sports de Val d'Isère
programs.contactActivity: One outreach email sent after Pascal’s referral; no reply yet.
programs.people: Lionel Fayolle; introduced by Pascal Arpin
programs.currentRead: Serious local U12 club. Pascal confirmed it as a relevant contact; cold outreach has now gone to Lionel.
programs.nextStep: Await reply, then follow up if needed.

programs.name: Ski Zenit
programs.contactActivity: Active exchange — initial reply, follow-up questions, a detailed second reply, a closing acknowledgement, and a later bookings confirmation.
programs.currentRead: Three-week January camp plus rolling private/shared training, but no fixed younger U12 group.
programs.nextStep: Keep as a flexible backup and revisit as 2028 plans firm up.

programs.name: Apex Perform Better / Les Crosets camps
programs.contactActivity: Active exchange — separate from the academy thread; camps reply received and acknowledged.
programs.currentRead: Weekly holiday-style camps for U10–U16, aiming to open partly in winter 2027 and fully in winter 2028. Not a continuous January–March race-team placement.
programs.nextStep: Wait for the November mailing-list update.
